image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed paper menu. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, appearing as 'gibberish' or AI-hallucinated characters rather than real words. There are decorative floral/scrollwork elements at the bottom which also show signs of structural incoherence. The background suggests a table setting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure of text generation. Characters are malformed, fused, and linguistically nonsensical. This is the primary artifact defining the image as AI-generated.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom decorative border and lower text lines
artifact_observations.reasoning: The floral/scroll designs at the bottom bleed into the text above them. The edges of the decorations are soft and undefined, lacking the sharpness of printed ink on paper.
Characters do not sit 'on' the paper surface; they appear to have varying depths and slight blurring that doesn't match a standard depth-of-field effect, suggesting generative smoothing.
